package controller

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"testing"
	"time"

	appsv1 "k8s.io/api/apps/v1"
	corev1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
	rbacv1 "k8s.io/api/rbac/v1"
	apierrors "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/api/errors"
	metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1/unstructured"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/runtime"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/util/intstr"
	"k8s.io/client-go/rest"
	ctrl "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/envtest"
	metricsserver "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/metrics/server"
	"sigs.k8s.io/yaml"
)

type integrationEnvironment struct {
	admin, limited           client.Client
	config                   *rest.Config
	scheme                   *runtime.Scheme
	hasService, requiredPort bool
	deploymentSuffix         string
}

func TestEnvtestGeneratedOperator(t *testing.T) {
	environment := startIntegrationEnvironment(t)
	if !t.Run("CRDSchemaAndSubresources", environment.checkSchema) {
		return
	}
	if !t.Run("GeneratedRBAC", environment.checkRBAC) {
		return
	}
	if !t.Run("Lifecycle", environment.checkLifecycle) {
		return
	}
	t.Run("ManagerWatches", environment.checkManager)
}

func startIntegrationEnvironment(t *testing.T) *integrationEnvironment {
	t.Helper()
	download := os.Getenv("KUBIAD_ENVTEST_DOWNLOAD") == "1"
	assets := os.Getenv("KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS")
	if assets == "" && !download {
		t.Fatal("envtest binaries are required")
	}
	useExisting := false
	controlPlane := &envtest.Environment{
		CRDDirectoryPaths:           []string{filepath.Join("..", "..", "config", "crd", "bases")},
		ErrorIfCRDPathMissing:       true,
		UseExistingCluster:          &useExisting,
		BinaryAssetsDirectory:       assets,
		DownloadBinaryAssets:        download && assets == "",
		DownloadBinaryAssetsVersion: "1.35.0",
		ControlPlaneStopTimeout:     15 * time.Second,
	}
	if controlPlane.DownloadBinaryAssets {
		directory, err := envtest.SetupEnvtestDefaultBinaryAssetsDirectory()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		controlPlane.BinaryAssetsDirectory = directory
	}
	controlPlane.ControlPlane.APIServer = &envtest.APIServer{}
	controlPlane.ControlPlane.APIServer.Configure().Set("enable-admission-plugins", "OwnerReferencesPermissionEnforcement")
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if err := controlPlane.Stop(); err != nil {
			t.Errorf("stop isolated control plane: %v", err)
		}
	})
	config, err := controlPlane.Start()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("start isolated Kubernetes API: %v", err)
	}
	scheme := runtime.NewScheme()
	for _, add := range []func(*runtime.Scheme) error{appsv1.AddToScheme, corev1.AddToScheme, rbacv1.AddToScheme} {
		if err := add(scheme); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	admin, err := client.New(config, client.Options{Scheme: scheme})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 15*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	for _, name := range []string{"kubiad-system", "operator-tests"} {
		if err := admin.Create(ctx, &corev1.Namespace{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: name}}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	for name, resource := range map[string]client.Object{
		"role.yaml":            &rbacv1.ClusterRole{},
		"service_account.yaml": &corev1.ServiceAccount{},
		"role_binding.yaml":    &rbacv1.ClusterRoleBinding{},
	} {
		data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("..", "..", "config", "rbac", name))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := yaml.UnmarshalStrict(data, resource); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("decode generated %s: %v", name, err)
		}
		if _, ok := resource.(*corev1.ServiceAccount); ok {
			resource.SetNamespace("kubiad-system")
		}
		if err := admin.Create(ctx, resource); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("install generated %s: %v", name, err)
		}
	}
	user, err := controlPlane.AddUser(envtest.User{
		Name:   "system:serviceaccount:kubiad-system:kubiad-controller-manager",
		Groups: []string{"system:serviceaccounts", "system:serviceaccounts:kubiad-system", "system:authenticated"},
	}, config)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	limited, err := client.New(user.Config(), client.Options{Scheme: scheme})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	kind := object().GetKind()
	environment := &integrationEnvironment{
		admin: admin, limited: limited, config: user.Config(), scheme: scheme,
		hasService: kind != "WorkerApplication", requiredPort: kind == "ScalableWebApplication",
		deploymentSuffix: "-application",
	}
	if !environment.hasService {
		environment.deploymentSuffix = "-worker"
	}
	eventually(t, "generated role becomes effective", func(ctx context.Context) error {
		list := &unstructured.UnstructuredList{}
		gvk := object().GroupVersionKind()
		list.SetGroupVersionKind(gvk.GroupVersion().WithKind(gvk.Kind + "List"))
		return limited.List(ctx, list, client.InNamespace("operator-tests"))
	})
	return environment
}

func (e *integrationEnvironment) application(name string) *unstructured.Unstructured {
	application := object()
	application.SetName(name)
	application.SetNamespace("operator-tests")
	spec := map[string]any{"image": "nginx:1.27"}
	if e.requiredPort {
		spec["port"] = int64(8080)
	}
	application.Object["spec"] = spec
	return application
}

func (e *integrationEnvironment) checkSchema(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := t.Context()
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name    string
		mutate  func(*unstructured.Unstructured)
		enabled bool
	}{
		{"missing-spec", func(a *unstructured.Unstructured) { delete(a.Object, "spec") }, true},
		{"missing-image", func(a *unstructured.Unstructured) { delete(a.Object["spec"].(map[string]any), "image") }, true},
		{"empty-image", func(a *unstructured.Unstructured) { a.Object["spec"].(map[string]any)["image"] = "" }, true},
		{"replicas-negative", func(a *unstructured.Unstructured) { a.Object["spec"].(map[string]any)["replicas"] = int64(-1) }, true},
		{"replicas-over-limit", func(a *unstructured.Unstructured) { a.Object["spec"].(map[string]any)["replicas"] = int64(11) }, true},
		{"port-zero", func(a *unstructured.Unstructured) { a.Object["spec"].(map[string]any)["port"] = int64(0) }, e.hasService},
		{"port-over-limit", func(a *unstructured.Unstructured) { a.Object["spec"].(map[string]any)["port"] = int64(65536) }, e.hasService},
		{"required-port", func(a *unstructured.Unstructured) { delete(a.Object["spec"].(map[string]any), "port") }, e.requiredPort},
	} {
		if !test.enabled {
			continue
		}
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			application := e.application(test.name)
			test.mutate(application)
			if err := e.admin.Create(ctx, application); !apierrors.IsInvalid(err) {
				t.Fatalf("API create error = %v, want Invalid", err)
			}
		})
	}
	application := e.application("schema")
	if err := e.admin.Create(ctx, application); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	replicas, _, err := unstructured.NestedInt64(application.Object, "spec", "replicas")
	if err != nil || replicas != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("default replicas = %d, %v", replicas, err)
	}
	if e.hasService {
		port, _, err := unstructured.NestedInt64(application.Object, "spec", "port")
		if err != nil || port != 8080 {
			t.Fatalf("port = %d, %v", port, err)
		}
	}
	application.Object["status"] = map[string]any{"phase": "Injected"}
	if err := e.admin.Update(ctx, application); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, found, _ := unstructured.NestedString(application.Object, "status", "phase"); found {
		t.Fatal("ordinary update changed the status subresource")
	}
	generation := application.GetGeneration()
	application.Object["spec"].(map[string]any)["image"] = "ignored:status-update"
	application.Object["status"] = map[string]any{"phase": "Manual", "readyReplicas": int64(0)}
	if err := e.admin.Status().Update(ctx, application); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	actual := object()
	if err := e.admin.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(application), actual); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	image, _, _ := unstructured.NestedString(actual.Object, "spec", "image")
	phase, _, _ := unstructured.NestedString(actual.Object, "status", "phase")
	if image != "nginx:1.27" || phase != "Manual" || actual.GetGeneration() != generation {
		t.Fatalf("status subresource isolation: spec=%s phase=%s generation=%d", image, phase, actual.GetGeneration())
	}
	if err := e.admin.Delete(ctx, actual); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func (e *integrationEnvironment) checkRBAC(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := t.Context()
	application := e.application("permissions")
	if err := e.admin.Create(ctx, application); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer func() {
		if err := e.admin.Delete(context.Background(), application); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
		}
	}()
	if err := e.limited.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(application), object()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mustBeForbidden(t, e.limited.Update(ctx, application))
	mustBeForbidden(t, e.limited.Create(ctx, e.application("forbidden-create")))
	mustBeForbidden(t, e.limited.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKey{Namespace: "operator-tests", Name: "credentials"}, &corev1.Secret{}))
	mustBeForbidden(t, e.limited.Delete(ctx, &appsv1.Deployment{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Namespace: "operator-tests", Name: "missing"}}))
	if !e.hasService {
		mustBeForbidden(t, e.limited.List(ctx, &corev1.ServiceList{}, client.InNamespace("operator-tests")))
	}
}

func (e *integrationEnvironment) checkLifecycle(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := t.Context()
	application := e.application("lifecycle")
	if err := e.admin.Create(ctx, application); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	reconciler := &Reconciler{Client: e.limited, Scheme: e.scheme}
	reconcile := func() {
		t.Helper()
		if _, err := reconciler.Reconcile(ctx, ctrl.Request{NamespacedName: client.ObjectKeyFromObject(application)}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	reconcile()
	e.assertDesired(t, application, 1, "nginx:1.27", 8080)
	e.assertStatus(t, application, "Progressing", 0)
	before := e.resourceVersions(t, application)
	reconcile()
	if after := e.resourceVersions(t, application); !reflect.DeepEqual(before, after) {
		t.Fatalf("unchanged reconcile wrote objects: before=%v after=%v", before, after)
	}
	e.markReady(t, application, 1)
	reconcile()
	e.assertStatus(t, application, "Ready", 1)
	e.updateSpec(t, application, 2, "nginx:1.28", 9090)
	reconcile()
	e.assertDesired(t, application, 2, "nginx:1.28", 9090)
	e.assertStatus(t, application, "Progressing", 1)
	for _, test := range []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(*appsv1.DeploymentStatus)
	}{
		{"stale-generation", func(s *appsv1.DeploymentStatus) { s.ObservedGeneration-- }},
		{"incomplete-update", func(s *appsv1.DeploymentStatus) { s.UpdatedReplicas-- }},
		{"extra-replicas", func(s *appsv1.DeploymentStatus) { s.Replicas++ }},
		{"incomplete-availability", func(s *appsv1.DeploymentStatus) { s.AvailableReplicas-- }},
	} {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			deployment := e.deployment(t, application)
			deployment.Status = appsv1.DeploymentStatus{ObservedGeneration: deployment.Generation, Replicas: 2, UpdatedReplicas: 2, AvailableReplicas: 2, ReadyReplicas: 2}
			test.mutate(&deployment.Status)
			if err := e.admin.Status().Update(t.Context(), deployment); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if _, err := reconciler.Reconcile(t.Context(), ctrl.Request{NamespacedName: client.ObjectKeyFromObject(application)}); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			e.assertStatus(t, application, "Progressing", 2)
			e.assertDesired(t, application, 2, "nginx:1.28", 9090)
		})
	}
	e.markReady(t, application, 2)
	reconcile()
	e.assertStatus(t, application, "Ready", 2)

	deployment := e.deployment(t, application)
	*deployment.Spec.Replicas = 4
	deployment.Spec.Template.Spec.Containers[0].Image = "drift:latest"
	deployment.Spec.Template.Labels["drift"] = "true"
	if err := e.admin.Update(ctx, deployment); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	clusterIP := ""
	if e.hasService {
		service := e.service(t, application)
		clusterIP = service.Spec.ClusterIP
		if clusterIP == "" {
			t.Fatal("API did not allocate a ClusterIP")
		}
		service.Spec.Selector = map[string]string{"drift": "true"}
		service.Spec.Ports[0].Port = 9999
		service.Spec.Ports[0].TargetPort = intstr.FromInt32(9998)
		if err := e.admin.Update(ctx, service); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	reconcile()
	e.assertDesired(t, application, 2, "nginx:1.28", 9090)
	if e.hasService && e.service(t, application).Spec.ClusterIP != clusterIP {
		t.Fatal("ClusterIP changed during drift correction")
	}

	e.updateSpec(t, application, 0, "nginx:1.28", 9090)
	reconcile()
	e.assertDesired(t, application, 0, "nginx:1.28", 9090)
	e.assertStatus(t, application, "Progressing", 2)
	e.markReady(t, application, 0)
	reconcile()
	e.assertStatus(t, application, "Ready", 0)
	before = e.resourceVersions(t, application)
	reconcile()
	if after := e.resourceVersions(t, application); !reflect.DeepEqual(before, after) {
		t.Fatalf("stable zero-replica reconcile wrote objects: before=%v after=%v", before, after)
	}
	e.updateSpec(t, application, 3, "nginx:1.28", 9090)
	reconcile()
	e.assertDesired(t, application, 3, "nginx:1.28", 9090)
	e.assertStatus(t, application, "Progressing", 0)
	e.markReady(t, application, 3)
	reconcile()
	e.assertStatus(t, application, "Ready", 3)
	missing := ctrl.Request{NamespacedName: client.ObjectKey{Namespace: "operator-tests", Name: "does-not-exist"}}
	if _, err := reconciler.Reconcile(ctx, missing); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("missing primary resource: %v", err)
	}
}

func (e *integrationEnvironment) deployment(t *testing.T, application *unstructured.Unstructured) *appsv1.Deployment {
	t.Helper()
	deployment := &appsv1.Deployment{}
	key := client.ObjectKey{Namespace: application.GetNamespace(), Name: application.GetName() + e.deploymentSuffix}
	if err := e.admin.Get(t.Context(), key, deployment); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return deployment
}

func (e *integrationEnvironment) service(t *testing.T, application *unstructured.Unstructured) *corev1.Service {
	t.Helper()
	service := &corev1.Service{}
	key := client.ObjectKey{Namespace: application.GetNamespace(), Name: application.GetName() + "-application-service"}
	if err := e.admin.Get(t.Context(), key, service); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return service
}

func (e *integrationEnvironment) assertDesired(t *testing.T, application *unstructured.Unstructured, replicas int32, image string, port int32) {
	t.Helper()
	deployment := e.deployment(t, application)
	if len(deployment.Spec.Template.Spec.Containers) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("Deployment has %d containers, want one", len(deployment.Spec.Template.Spec.Containers))
	}
	if deployment.Spec.Replicas == nil || *deployment.Spec.Replicas != replicas || deployment.Spec.Template.Spec.Containers[0].Image != image {
		t.Fatalf("desired Deployment differs: %#v", deployment.Spec)
	}
	e.assertOwner(t, application, deployment)
	labels := deployment.Spec.Selector.MatchLabels
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(labels, deployment.Spec.Template.Labels) || labels["kubiad.dev/instance"] != application.GetName() {
		t.Fatalf("Deployment selector/template labels differ: %#v", deployment.Spec)
	}
	if e.hasService {
		service := e.service(t, application)
		e.assertOwner(t, application, service)
		if len(service.Spec.Ports) != 1 || len(deployment.Spec.Template.Spec.Containers[0].Ports) != 1 {
			t.Fatal("expected one Service port and one container port")
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(service.Spec.Selector, labels) || service.Spec.Ports[0].Port != port || service.Spec.Ports[0].TargetPort.IntVal != port || deployment.Spec.Template.Spec.Containers[0].Ports[0].ContainerPort != port {
			t.Fatalf("Service/Deployment port or selector mismatch: %#v / %#v", service.Spec, deployment.Spec)
		}
	} else {
		if len(deployment.Spec.Template.Spec.Containers[0].Ports) != 0 {
			t.Fatal("worker has an unexpected port")
		}
		services := &corev1.ServiceList{}
		if err := e.admin.List(t.Context(), services, client.InNamespace(application.GetNamespace())); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if len(services.Items) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("worker created Services: %#v", services.Items)
		}
	}
}

func (e *integrationEnvironment) assertOwner(t *testing.T, application *unstructured.Unstructured, resource client.Object) {
	t.Helper()
	owner := metav1.GetControllerOf(resource)
	if owner == nil || owner.UID != application.GetUID() || owner.Name != application.GetName() || owner.Kind != application.GetKind() || owner.APIVersion != application.GetAPIVersion() {
		t.Fatalf("incorrect controller owner: %#v", owner)
	}
}

func (e *integrationEnvironment) assertStatus(t *testing.T, application *unstructured.Unstructured, phase string, ready int64) {
	t.Helper()
	actual := object()
	if err := e.admin.Get(t.Context(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(application), actual); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	actualPhase, _, err := unstructured.NestedString(actual.Object, "status", "phase")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	actualReady, _, err := unstructured.NestedInt64(actual.Object, "status", "readyReplicas")
	if err != nil || actualPhase != phase || actualReady != ready {
		t.Fatalf("status = (%q,%d,%v), want (%q,%d)", actualPhase, actualReady, err, phase, ready)
	}
}

func (e *integrationEnvironment) resourceVersions(t *testing.T, application *unstructured.Unstructured) []string {
	t.Helper()
	actual := object()
	if err := e.admin.Get(t.Context(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(application), actual); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	versions := []string{actual.GetResourceVersion(), e.deployment(t, application).ResourceVersion}
	if e.hasService {
		versions = append(versions, e.service(t, application).ResourceVersion)
	}
	return versions
}

func (e *integrationEnvironment) updateSpec(t *testing.T, application *unstructured.Unstructured, replicas int64, image string, port int64) {
	t.Helper()
	current := object()
	if err := e.admin.Get(t.Context(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(application), current); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	spec := map[string]any{"image": image, "replicas": replicas}
	if e.hasService {
		spec["port"] = port
	}
	current.Object["spec"] = spec
	if err := e.admin.Update(t.Context(), current); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func (e *integrationEnvironment) markReady(t *testing.T, application *unstructured.Unstructured, replicas int32) {
	t.Helper()
	deployment := e.deployment(t, application)
	deployment.Status = appsv1.DeploymentStatus{ObservedGeneration: deployment.Generation, Replicas: replicas, UpdatedReplicas: replicas, AvailableReplicas: replicas, ReadyReplicas: replicas}
	if err := e.admin.Status().Update(t.Context(), deployment); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func (e *integrationEnvironment) checkManager(t *testing.T) {
	manager, err := ctrl.NewManager(e.config, ctrl.Options{
		Scheme: e.scheme, Metrics: metricsserver.Options{BindAddress: "0"}, HealthProbeBindAddress: "0",
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	reconciler := &Reconciler{Client: manager.GetClient(), Scheme: manager.GetScheme()}
	if err := reconciler.SetupWithManager(manager); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	stopped := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { stopped <- manager.Start(ctx) }()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		cancel()
		select {
		case err := <-stopped:
			if err != nil {
				t.Errorf("stop manager: %v", err)
			}
		case <-time.After(15 * time.Second):
			t.Error("manager did not stop")
		}
	})
	syncCtx, syncCancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 20*time.Second)
	defer syncCancel()
	if !manager.GetCache().WaitForCacheSync(syncCtx) {
		t.Fatal("manager cache did not sync")
	}
	application := e.application("watched")
	if err := e.admin.Create(t.Context(), application); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	deploymentKey := client.ObjectKey{Namespace: application.GetNamespace(), Name: application.GetName() + e.deploymentSuffix}
	eventually(t, "primary watch creates Deployment", func(ctx context.Context) error {
		return e.admin.Get(ctx, deploymentKey, &appsv1.Deployment{})
	})
	if e.hasService {
		eventually(t, "primary watch creates Service", func(ctx context.Context) error {
			return e.admin.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKey{Namespace: application.GetNamespace(), Name: application.GetName() + "-application-service"}, &corev1.Service{})
		})
	}
	e.updateSpec(t, application, 3, "nginx:1.29", 9191)
	eventually(t, "spec update reaches Deployment", func(ctx context.Context) error {
		deployment := &appsv1.Deployment{}
		if err := e.admin.Get(ctx, deploymentKey, deployment); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if *deployment.Spec.Replicas != 3 || deployment.Spec.Template.Spec.Containers[0].Image != "nginx:1.29" {
			return fmt.Errorf("spec not reconciled")
		}
		return nil
	})
	deployment := e.deployment(t, application)
	deployment.Spec.Template.Spec.Containers[0].Image = "watch-drift:latest"
	if err := e.admin.Update(t.Context(), deployment); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	eventually(t, "Deployment ownership watch repairs drift", func(ctx context.Context) error {
		deployment := &appsv1.Deployment{}
		if err := e.admin.Get(ctx, deploymentKey, deployment); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if deployment.Spec.Template.Spec.Containers[0].Image != "nginx:1.29" {
			return fmt.Errorf("drift not repaired")
		}
		return nil
	})
	if e.hasService {
		service := e.service(t, application)
		service.Spec.Ports[0].Port = 9999
		if err := e.admin.Update(t.Context(), service); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		eventually(t, "Service ownership watch repairs drift", func(ctx context.Context) error {
			service := &corev1.Service{}
			if err := e.admin.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKey{Namespace: application.GetNamespace(), Name: application.GetName() + "-application-service"}, service); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if service.Spec.Ports[0].Port != 9191 {
				return fmt.Errorf("Service drift not repaired")
			}
			return nil
		})
	}
	e.markReady(t, application, 3)
	eventually(t, "Deployment status watch updates primary status", func(ctx context.Context) error {
		actual := object()
		if err := e.admin.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(application), actual); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		phase, _, _ := unstructured.NestedString(actual.Object, "status", "phase")
		ready, _, _ := unstructured.NestedInt64(actual.Object, "status", "readyReplicas")
		if phase != "Ready" || ready != 3 {
			return fmt.Errorf("status = %s/%d", phase, ready)
		}
		return nil
	})
}

func eventually(t *testing.T, description string, check func(context.Context) error) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(t.Context(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	ticker := time.NewTicker(100 * time.Millisecond)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	var last error
	for {
		if last = check(ctx); last == nil {
			return
		}
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v (last error: %v)", description, ctx.Err(), last)
		case <-ticker.C:
		}
	}
}

func mustBeForbidden(t *testing.T, err error) {
	t.Helper()
	if !apierrors.IsForbidden(err) {
		t.Fatalf("permission error = %v, want Forbidden", err)
	}
}
